title: Filling: the attached file, the instruction text and the two layouts
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. A filled inspection with a follow-up carrying a long instruction (with paragraph breaks) and an attached file with a long name; on desktop and a phone.
custom_steps:
1. On OK or N/A, first click Instruction in the card footer to expand it. Click the attached file's name and confirm it opens full screen in the same view and closes back to the exact position in the inspection; the file name is the hyperlink that opens it, and there is no separate "View Instruction" button.
2. Confirm instruction text is never truncated and the author's paragraph breaks are preserved, while long file names shorten.
3. Confirm desktop and phone are two layouts; on a phone confirm the acknowledgement takes its own full-width row below the file row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The attached file opens full screen in the same view and closes back to the exact position in the inspection; the file name is a hyperlink that opens it, with no separate "View Instruction" button.
  • Instruction text is never truncated and the author's paragraph breaks are preserved, while long file names shorten.
  • Desktop and phone are two layouts; on a phone the acknowledgement takes its own full-width row below the file row.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-10243 (S19 — Conditional follow-up on a checkbox response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S19; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R19: “The attached file will open full screen in the same view and close back to the exact position in the inspection, as the reference file already does. The file name is a hyperlink that opens it; there is no separate "View Instruction" button”
  • S19-R20: “Instruction text will never be truncated, and the author's paragraph breaks will be preserved. Long file names will shorten”
  • S19-R21: “Desktop and phone will be two layouts rather than one compressed. On a phone the acknowledgement takes its own full-width row below the file row, because the file row has no width to spare and the target has to be hittable with a gloved thumb”

Amended on 13 October 2026
S19-R19 changed on 7 October 2026, decided on SV-10794 (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, read on 13 October 2026): the file name is a hyperlink that opens the file; there is no "View Instruction" button. The quote above is the current wording; step 1 and the expected results follow it. Step 1 also says that on OK or N/A the instruction is first expanded from the Instruction action in the card footer (S19-R15).

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
